defectsDemonstrated.existingCaptureImpact: No accepted current/quality/companion record mismatch demonstrated: family wrappers supply fixed primitive constants.
defectsDemonstrated.correction: Validate captureVersion and purpose with existing primitive identifier grammar before constructing/encoding the envelope. No family registry or scientific logic added to shared code.

adversarialReview.sharedScope: One production encoder/digest implementation. Shared code contains no family-specific IDs/contracts/reference protocols, source schema, species, archive or publication policy. It reuses existing generic data/identifier helpers.
adversarialReview.explicitDomains: Serialization/digest versions are fixed shared constants; capture version and purpose are explicit fixed caller constants. Missing/malformed/object/inherited/accessor domain parameters fail before traversal. Substituted well-formed strings compute another domain, never validate under a fixed family capture/reference protocol.
adversarialReview.currentPreservation: All 24 original pre-extraction goldens unchanged and passing; existing 160-test current exact suite required unchanged. New domain guard affects only malformed newly exposed internal port calls, not checkpointed current-v2 behavior.
adversarialReview.signedZeros: Nine independent exact projection cases and eight mixed-sign configurations pass. All nine sign-conflicting duplicate fields tested in both orders at their exact family objects.
adversarialReview.namespaces: All six cross-family cec2/wmq2/mac2 ID substitutions fail. Cross-family digest/purpose/version and malformed namespace attacks fail.
adversarialReview.binding: Quality authority/reference, lineage/order, quality time, coordinates, acquisition and sign substitutions invalidate old companions. Compatible explicit rebuilds produce distinct companion identities.
adversarialReview.provenance: Existing speed OR gust OR direction availability consistency preserved; complete normalized replay including six source leaves compared before assembler output.
adversarialReview.publication: Both exact protocols bind under existing V3 reference-only semantics. Cross-family/version changes produce distinct publication content; tampering with existing publication fails. V3 may record an arbitrary newly supplied opaque reference, which is not source resolution or family authorization; exact typed validators reject incompatible references. No ambiguous alias demonstrated.
adversarialReview.safety: Descriptor/private/schema protections and all prior attacks retained; golden fixtures unmodified; no post-replay sign repair.
